uncited: It sets itself apart from sibling methods by the specific mathematical representation of the deformation field: while some use cubic B-splines for sparse data efficiency [Spline-based Deformation Field](11457-spline-based-deformation-field.md), others use MLPs guided by parametric models like 3DMMs [Deformation-Guided Neural Fields](12044-deformation-guided-neural-fields.md) or inverse Linear Blend Skinning (LBS) with neural residuals [Neural Deformation Field](12724-neural-deformation-field.md).
All methods in this family rely on the differentiability of the forward rendering operator and the propagation of gradients through the integration steps.
The core mechanism is the evaluation of the volume rendering equation and the computation of gradients with respect to scene parameters (density, geometry, transfer functions, camera poses).
